Explore LCFR [SOLD OUT] Nergal of Behemoth signature Explore Paranormal II [SOLD OUT] Gary Holt Gary Holt Parametric EQ Overdrive vol.2 Explore Ascendancy by Trivium [SOLD OUT] Dual Pedal for Matthew and Corey of Trivium Explore Unicorn Blood II Limited edition octave fuzz 2020 Explore Unicorn Blood [SOLD OUT] Limited edition octave fuzz 2018 Explore Paranormal [SOLD OUT] Gary Holt Parametric EQ Overdrive Explore Scuzz Box Germanium-voiced fuzz with a gnarly 8-bit twist Explore Abyss A game changing bass overdrive Explore No.1 A tube-like overdriven amp on your pedalboard Explore Fallout Bass Overdrive by Dave Ellefson of Megadeth Explore No.2 Much more than a precision clean boost Explore Scuzz Box Germanium-voiced fuzz with a gnarly 8-bit twist Cost: $ 199.95 A powerfully crunchy, ripping tone that can scream and destroy but is clear enough for soloing. In its acid yellow and purple enclosure the Scuzz Box is inspired by the best fuzz pedals throughout the generations, taken to the next level. “Most fuzz pedals I’ve tried sound cool on high notes, but once you get into rhythm it’s just a wash of fuzz. The Scuzz Box doesn’t mute any notes and maintains clarity.” – Dave Catching (Eagles of Death Metal) The Scuzz Box shines in two distinct modes: Scuzz and Fuzz. The Fuzz mode is your go-to, highly listenable sound with top-notch fuzz. Designed to shine through and stand out, this mode is perfect for soloing and long wailing tones, clear enough even for power chords. The Scuzz mode is where this pedal gets gnarly, dangerous and unpredictable. It delivers a velcro-type gating fuzz with a highly distinct ripping texture and an 8-bit tone. The Buffer eliminates unwanted oscillation and helps retain clarity, reducing passive signal loss in longer cables. We've made it truly bypassable for easy access. Technology The Scuzz Box is built on discrete transistors technology with a high-precision circuit for the highest performance, with added internal elements in the bias. Like all KHDK pedals, the Scuzz Box is proudly crafted and quality-tested in Kentucky, USA. Awards Explore the tone Videos Controls & Specs Reviews Artists Downloads Videos Scuzz Box TEASER (ft. KHDK Electronics Scuzz Box Fuzz Effect Pedal quantity Add to cart Free shipping on orders over $40 100% Secure & Encrypted Payments Categories: Effects Description Reviews (0) Who doesnt like a good germanium fuzz? This is the KHDK Scuzz Box, a fuzz built with a finely tuned circuit that was inspired by the iconic fuzzes of the 1960s. The Scuzz has two modes: its namesake, and regular Fuzz. The Fuzz is a highly dynamic, articulate fuzz tone. Every note is meant to be heard and it cleans up beautifully with your guitar volume.The Scuzz brings a dangerous, unique and biting sound. It is an unpredictable, ruckus velcro-type gated fuzz with a nasty, gnarly and buzzy tone with ripping textures. Thanks to a cleverly-used gating effect, the sustaining notes die quickly with virtually no residual noise. The final sound is mercurial and oscillating with tinges of 8-bit. Its pretty wild. Note that the Scuzz is too powerful and the sound too highly compressed to be controlled by your guitars volume. It can be silent or extremely loud: nothing in between. Buffer eliminates the unwanted oscillation that may occur with effects placed in front of the Scuzz Box. The switch helps retain clarity and eliminates passive signal loss in longer cables.
